title: Facile fabrication of robust superhydrophobic tapered needles for collection and transportation of underwater bubbles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8663-8674
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06971D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huicong Liu, Huaxia Wang, Liqun Zhu, Weiping Li, Haining Chen, Weitao Liang
This study successfully fabricated robust superhydrophobic tapered needles via an organic–inorganic hybrid coating method, achieving a 156° contact angle, exceptional surface stability, and efficient underwater bubble manipulation.
